science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The jagged crags overlooking the coastal expanse shuddered violently as the wind tore through the canyon. Below, a tempest of liquid metal rolled and crashed against the shore, glowing with the furious azure light of raw magnetic induction. Hector hauled himself onto the outcropping, breathless, his heavy leather coat crackling with a residual static tang that tasted distinctly like ozone and rusted pennies. He checked the main induction coil, grinning wildly at the sheer force of the storm, before turning to his squadmate who had just arrived. Without hesitation, he tossed the pulsing telemetry baton squarely into the awaiting hands of Kaio, signaling the scout to map the volatile currents.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Establish a stable grounding shunt near the ferrofluid coast.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Map the magnetic shear patterns for the Genesis Garden.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Complete the Stormbreaker Spire to harness the planet's core energy.
